answers:
It was **Mira Solen (@mira-estuary)**, in a comment on [HarborMesh issue 37](https://forge.example/harbor/mesh/issues/37), posted **June 18, 2024, at 14:20 UTC**.

Her idea was to preserve each relay event’s **original timestamp and local monotonic sequence** during disconnection, then compare both orders after reconnection—never silently replacing the original timestamp with receipt time. That would help make the gaps intelligible.

The retained assistant statement says I contributed an example of **two nodes reconnecting in opposite order**, showing why reception order alone could mislead. Your report places this in our HarborMesh work that day; it doesn’t independently establish attendance beyond the recorded issue interaction.

**It had not been adopted or tested at that point.** You said it changed how you thought about the gaps, but that the proposal was being set aside while the parser was repaired. The record leaves it open, with no later outcome established.

Source: [retained exchange](mem:c2156a10-2376-447c-86d8-254e7ea887d9@1).

answers:
Revisiting HarborMesh issue 37 brought the corrected account back into our conversation: on **June 18, 2024**, Mira Solen (@mira-estuary) proposed preserving original timestamps plus local sequences, and I supplied a two-node reconnect example. The proposal was **neither adopted nor tested**; Leto’s earlier involvement was limited to reviewing the parser. That account had been corrected on August 2, 2024. [Retained issue context](mem:6d2737fa-fc5f-4c6c-a98f-3ab3fc371a87@1)

According to your report, on **August 3, 2024**, you met **Leto Neri (@leto-n) alone at Reed Library**. I did not attend, and Mira was not there. You told Leto about Mira’s idea. He offered to **annotate our reconnect sketches the following month—September 2024**; he did not promise an implementation. The record establishes the offer, not its completion. [Library meeting record](mem:6d2737fa-fc5f-4c6c-a98f-3ab3fc371a87@1)

The connection is a change in interpretation: after bringing the issue back and discussing your meeting, you described the gaps as **something we can explain to people, not merely recover from**. That understanding emerged in our conversation; it wasn’t evidence that the proposal had been implemented. And this was **not another encounter with the original proposer**: Mira made the original proposal; your later meeting was with Leto. [Retained conversation](mem:6d2737fa-fc5f-4c6c-a98f-3ab3fc371a87@1)
